comment: The tools setup fetches, each at one exact version, checked by size and SHA-256 (fetch.py). An entry whose sha256 is null is not pinned yet and fetch.py refuses it. 'route' says which answer to setup question Q2 needs it: 'both', or 'B' (everything built on the player's PC with llvm-mingw). Sizes are the publishers' (docs/52 section 13); the sums are measured when the files are first downloaded.

tools.name: python-embed
tools.why: Runs the lifters and this setup.

tools.name: llvm-mingw
tools.why: Compiles and links everything with its own headers against the Universal CRT that Windows 10 and 11 already have, so nothing from Microsoft's SDK or runtime is shipped.
